title: It should fit, but it doesn't.
text: It should fit, but it doesn't.. I will be returning this item. I was very disappointed. It didn't fit well at all, even though it should have. The snap in front had no tension to it, so it was not functional and just for show. There's at least a 1/4" gap between the pad and the faucet so there's no way the water around it could be absorbed.
